run renamed.awk
as records get .records
as first get .records[0]
run @first whole.awk
run @records whole.awk
run summary.awk --with $first --arg status passed --arg separator ,\040
run summary.awk --arg status failed --with $records --arg separator +
as none arr
run @none renamed.awk
run @none kinds.awk
run @none whole.awk
as scalar get .suite
run @scalar kinds.awk
run @scalar whole.awk
run @first kinds.awk
run missing.awk
run-bare renamed.awk
run renamed.awk --sorted
run summary.awk --with
run summary.awk --arg status
run summary.awk --arg a-b c
read-register
